roads.name: Artists Drive Scenic Loop
words: Properly twisty: 50 curves in 7.3 miles, about 7 a mile.
The 1.9 miles at the south end are tamer.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 12 to 953 ft, with 2,732 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 114°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 25 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.23 g.

roads.name: Dantes View Road

From 4,290 to 5,469 ft, with 1,169 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 91°F.
